text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While passing behind the academy
building, I
happen upon Nice Nature
having a discussion
with some friends.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahey! It's Nature's trainer! Bruh,
this is
a
super-lucky spawn! Someone grab a
phone. ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So right now, we're, like, about to make
a video
message for Nature's little bro!
Could you help
out and shoot it for us?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their double bombardment leaves me no
room to refuse. Before I know it, I'm
holding a smartphone
and ready to
record.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what's the best way to cheer on
someone who's learning to ride a
tricycle? Maybe we
should all shout
something together...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Don't you remember? We tried that and the result was so vanilla. A message from just his beloved big sis would be totally on point!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know it's for your bro, but not gonna
lie, I'm pretty surprised you're doing
something like this! I
thought you hated
mushy stuff.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well,
I'll admit this isn't my usual style...
But the power of cheering is nothing to
sniff at, you
know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Think about when you hear your name
being
called out during a race. It really
makes you want
to give your best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Sometimes I feel like getting cheered
on can only help so much, but it's also
true that those
cheers are kinda
motivating.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So I thought if I got the two most
enthusiastic people I know involved,
we'd be able to make a
really
encouraging video together...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No cap! For real, our vibes are hundo P in sync right now! When everyone's hyping you up, you literally get hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Omg, totes! Nature wants to support her bro the same way her fans support her!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Real talk, we gotta cook with this one!
Let's use
Nature's feels to boost the
festi-vibes! ☆ Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Okay! We'll make Nature's cheer clip
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah, r-right!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Aaand we're ready!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Time to film Nature's straight fire feels
mode
high-key hype festi-vibing vid!
Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Are these two serious?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, thanks... Wait. Wait, wait! What are
we exactly trying to achieve by sending
my brother a
video of me in a
cheerleader outfit?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The visuals are the first step towards
bringing the
hype! You'll be fine. That
fit's fire! Fax, no printer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Once he sees how real your cheers are,
your bro will do his best, too! Like, no
doubt! Okay, so
how should you actually
cheer for him?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like, if this vid was for you, Trainer,
how
would
you like to be cheered on?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Sisterly? I never dress like this at home,
though...
Well, I guess I'll do the best I
can...
choice_data_list: Cheering like a true big sister.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. ...So I heard you're practicing real
hard on that tricycle. That's some
impressive dedication!
Your big sis is
super proud!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You work way harder than me, so I'm
sure you'll be triking around in no time,
but your hopeless sis
wants to cheer you
on anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Give it your best! You got this! Don't be
scared!
Your big sis is with you all the
way!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You... You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Geez,
I can't keep this up. I'm starting
to lose
track of the real me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Sweet! This is actually so good! Your
aura's on
another level!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap, this could go high-key viral!
Hey, mind if
I throw it on UmaTok?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, but isn't that totally at odds with
my whole
deal?! Besides, who'd even
enjoy watching
something like that?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I bet your trainer would get way hyped
watching
it! I'm telling you, it'll slap!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Totes! And your bro's totally gonna love
it too!
C'mon, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, fine! I get it. I'll do it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm the one who was talking
about the
power of cheers in the first
place...
One, two, three...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Go! You can do it! ♪ You can do it! ♪
Tricycles
are nothing to fear! ☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Go! Right foot! ♪ Go! Left foot! ♪ Push
those
pedals! ♪ Push on forward! ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ride that trike! ♪ You can do it!
Yeahhh! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Sweet! This is actually so good! Your
aura's on
another level!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No cap, this could go high-key viral!
Hey, mind if
I throw it on UmaTok?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: High-key no.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those two helped out a lot, and we did
finish the video... but can I really send
this? My brother's going to laugh so
hard if he watches it when he's
older...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...No,
I'll send it. This is probably going
to come
back to haunt me, though...
choice_data_list: Then why don't you see them off?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
All four of us put our cheers into it,
right? I think
it'll really encourage my
brother.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature watches her video with a
subtle hint
of pride. It looks like this was
a valuable
experience for her!
